summary: Screen climate hazards, map asset exposure, and prioritize adaptation, maintenance, and investment actions. Explore the practical five-day course.
lede: Physical climate risk assessment helps asset owners, facilities managers, infrastructure planners, and risk managers screen hazards across portfolios. Participants learn to map exposure in QGIS, assess asset vulnerability and criticality, and compare adaptation options with maintenance and investment needs. Portfolio exercises support a documented, prioritized resilience plan for facilities, infrastructure, and utility assets, while advanced projections and AI-assisted hazard analytics are introduced conceptually.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who assess physical climate hazards and make asset, maintenance, insurance, or infrastructure planning decisions across one or multiple sites.
modules: IPCC Climate Hazards and Asset Resilience
prerequisites: Working familiarity with facilities, infrastructure, asset management, insurance risk, or climate-risk responsibilities is expected. Basic spreadsheet use is helpful; no coding or prior GIS experience is required.
